metadata.name: Google Groundsource Flash Flood Observations Subset (Alachua Watershed Focus)
metadata.provenance: Google Research Groundsource Open Dataset (Released March 2026)
metadata.extraction_model: Gemini Multimodal Disaster News Processing Pipeline
scientific_caveats: Extracted from news reports via Gemini NLP entity recognition and temporal anchoring.
Susceptible to reporting bias: urban centers and affluent corridors generate more news mentions than unpopulated areas.
Not a calibrated hydraulic depth model or parcel-level inundation probability guarantee.
Provides empirical historical disaster context to prioritize stormwater mitigation.
metadata.notice: Historical development fixture. Not loaded by the application. See groundsource_verified_florida.geojson for authenticated records.

properties.headline: Hogtown Creek overflows banks after 4.2-inch deluge, submerging trail crossings
properties.excerpt: Rapid stormwater runoff from upland commercial zones surged into Hogtown Creek, pushing waters two feet over downstream footbridges within 45 minutes.

properties.headline: Retention ditch overflow cuts off residential cul-de-sac during tropical downpour
properties.excerpt: County emergency crews deployed pumps after culverts jammed with debris and downstream wetlands reached saturation capacity.

properties.headline: Sheet runoff from shopping center inundates downhill driveways
properties.excerpt: Neighbors reported heavy sheet runoff cascading off newly resurfaced parking stalls down toward adjacent residential swales.

properties.headline: Wetland preserve perimeter flooded during Hurricane Ian outer spiral bands
properties.excerpt: Runoff from across northwest Gainesville converged on the low-lying outlet marsh, cresting 3.1 feet above typical autumn levels.

properties.headline: Depot Park basin overflow threatens historic rail corridor structures
properties.excerpt: Downtown storm sewers backed up as continuous rainfall dumped 5 inches over 3 hours, turning roadways into standing canals.

properties.headline: Flash flood submerges vehicles on South Main Street underpass
properties.excerpt: Gainesville Fire Rescue assisted three stranded motorists after sudden storm drainage failure left 3 feet of water under the rail bridge.

properties.headline: Commercial warehouse district reports repeated floor flooding during summer storm
properties.excerpt: Flat asphalt lots and lack of permeable storage led to repeated localized ponding reaching warehouse roll-up doorways.

properties.headline: Sweetwater Branch wetlands exceed bankfull stage following Hurricane Idalia rains
properties.excerpt: Constructed wetland cells successfully buffered 80% of urban surge, but adjacent trail connections were closed for 4 days.

properties.headline: Intense cloudburst overwhelms downtown storm drains, filling parking lots
properties.excerpt: University area businesses experienced floor seepage after 3.8 inches fell in less than 90 minutes on unshaded paved aprons.

properties.headline: Flash flood advisory issued as street runoff pools on University Ave
properties.excerpt: Severe afternoon storm generated localized street flooding on heavily paved intersections with minimal tree cover.
